area: Sidebar - Work Order List and Search
title: 'Search work orders' matches the work order number
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. Several work orders exist with different numbers.
3. You are on the Schedule page with the work order list visible.
steps: 1. Click the 'Search work orders' field at the top of the list.
2. Type the number of one specific work order.
expected: 1. The list narrows to the card(s) whose work order number matches what you typed.
2. Cards that do not match disappear from the list.
